d390_boost.about: The RenderThread's boost with compose-rs's own hint session (D390), computed from this run's traces: per run (scenario-app-run), the boost picture of HWUI's counter alone (hwui_min, as render_boost), of compose-rs's session's minimum (app_min), and of the higher of both sessions' active CPU votes (effective_votes: what the power HAL applies), plus CPU time and work by thread kind over the measured window (13 s scrolling, 9 s animating).
